t2.title: People in cities be allowed to keep pets
t2.prompt: You are participating in an online discussion forum. The topic is: "Should people in cities be allowed to keep pets?" Write your response, giving reasons and examples. Write 180–200 words.
t2.sample:
Pet ownership in cities is a debated topic. I believe people should be allowed to keep pets, but with certain responsibilities.

Firstly, pets provide emotional support and companionship. Studies show that pet owners have lower stress levels and better mental health. For people living alone in cities, pets combat loneliness effectively.

Secondly, pets encourage physical activity. Dog owners regularly walk their pets, which promotes exercise and creates social connections with other pet owners in the neighborhood.

However, critics argue that city apartments are too small for animals. Moreover, noise complaints and hygiene issues can disturb neighbors. These are valid concerns that require responsible ownership.

Nevertheless, solutions exist. Pet-friendly buildings with designated areas, strict regulations on waste disposal, and choosing appropriate breeds for small spaces can address most problems.

In conclusion, banning pets in cities is unnecessary. With proper regulations and responsible owners, humans and animals can coexist harmoniously in urban environments.
t2.sampleA1:
Hi!
I have a cat. I like cats. Cats are nice. My cat is small. It lives in my house. I think pets are good. Bye!
t2.sampleA2:
Hello,
I think people can have pets in cities because pets are good. I have a dog and he is my friend. He needs to go outside, and I walk him in the park. But some people don't like dogs because they are noisy. It is important to clean up after your pet. I think if you take care of your pet, it is okay.
Bye.
t2.sampleB1:
I think people should be allowed to have pets in cities. Pets are good companions, and they can make people happy. For example, having a dog encourages you to go outside and exercise. This is important, especially in cities where people might not get enough exercise.

However, I understand that some people have concerns. Some apartments are small, and it might not be fair to keep a large dog in a small space. Also, pets can be noisy and disturb neighbors. Therefore, it's important for pet owners to be responsible. They should make sure their pets get enough exercise and that they don't cause problems for other people.

In my opinion, if people are responsible pet owners, there's no reason why they shouldn't be allowed to keep pets in cities.
t2.sampleB2: Hi everyone, This is a topic close to my heart, so I couldn't resist joining in. In my view, people in cities should absolutely be allowed to keep pets. For those living on their own, a pet can be a real source of comfort. After a stressful day at work, coming home to a wagging tail can genuinely lift your spirits and keep loneliness at bay. On top of that, dog owners tend to get out and about more, which does wonders for both body and mind. That said, I do see the other side of the argument. Cramped flats aren't ideal for larger breeds, and a barking dog can easily get on the neighbours' nerves. Mess left on the pavement is another common complaint. Even so, none of these problems are impossible to sort out. Responsible owners who clean up after their pets, choose suitable breeds and stick to the rules make all the difference. With a bit of common sense, humans and animals can live side by side, even in the busiest cities. What does everyone else reckon? I'd love to hear your thoughts! Dilnoza Karimova
t2.uzSample:
Shaharlarda uy hayvonlariga egalik qilish bahsli mavzu. Menimcha, odamlarga uy hayvonlarini saqlashga ruxsat berilishi kerak, lekin ma'lum mas'uliyatlar bilan.

Birinchidan, uy hayvonlari hissiy yordam va hamrohlikni ta'minlaydi. Tadqiqotlar shuni ko'rsatadiki, uy hayvonlari egalari stress darajasi pastroq va ruhiy salomatligi yaxshiroq bo'ladi. Shaharlarda yolg'iz yashaydigan odamlar uchun uy hayvonlari yolg'izlikka qarshi samarali kurashadi.

Ikkinchidan, uy hayvonlari jismoniy faollikni rag'batlantiradi. It egalari muntazam ravishda uy hayvonlarini sayr qildiradi, bu esa mashq qilishga yordam beradi va qo'shnilar bilan boshqa uy hayvonlari egalari o'rtasida ijtimoiy aloqalarni yaratadi.

Biroq, tanqidchilar shahar kvartiralari hayvonlar uchun juda kichik ekanligini ta'kidlaydilar. Bundan tashqari, shovqin shikoyatlari va gigiena muammolari qo'shnilarga xalaqit berishi mumkin. Bular mas'uliyatli egalikni talab qiladigan asosli xavotirlardir.

Shunga qaramay, yechimlar mavjud. Uy hayvonlari uchun qulay binolar, chiqindilarni yo'q qilish bo'yicha qat'iy qoidalar va kichik joylar uchun mos zotlarni tanlash ko'pgina muammolarni hal qilishi mumkin.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, shaharlarda uy hayvonlarini taqiqlashning hojati yo'q. Tegishli qoidalar va mas'uliyatli egalar bilan odamlar va hayvonlar shahar muhitida uyg'unlikda yashashi mumkin.
t2.uzSampleA1:
Salom!
Mening mushugim bor. Men mushuklarni yaxshi ko'raman. Mushuklar yaxshi. Mening mushugim kichkina. U mening uyimda yashaydi. Menimcha uy hayvonlari yaxshi. Xayr!
t2.uzSampleA2:
Salom,
Menimcha, odamlar shaharlarda uy hayvonlariga ega bo'lishlari mumkin, chunki uy hayvonlari yaxshi. Mening itim bor va u mening do'stim. U tashqariga chiqishi kerak, va men uni parkda sayr qildraman. Lekin ba'zi odamlarga itlar yoqmaydi, chunki ular shovqinli. Uy hayvoningizdan keyin tozalash muhim. Agar siz uy hayvoningizga g'amxo'rlik qilsangiz, bu yaxshi deb o'ylayman.
Xayr.
t2.uzSampleB1:
Menimcha, odamlarga shaharlarda uy hayvonlari bo'lishiga ruxsat berish kerak. Uy hayvonlari yaxshi hamroh bo'lishi mumkin va ular odamlarni xursand qilishi mumkin. Misol uchun, itga ega bo'lish sizni tashqariga chiqib, mashq qilishga undaydi. Bu, ayniqsa, shaharlarda, odamlar yetarli mashq qilmasligi mumkin bo'lgan joylarda muhimdir.

Biroq, men ba'zi odamlarda xavotirlar borligini tushunaman. Ba'zi kvartiralar kichik va katta itni kichik joyda saqlash adolatdan bo'lmasligi mumkin. Shuningdek, uy hayvonlari shovqinli bo'lishi va qo'shnilarni bezovta qilishi mumkin. Shuning uchun, uy hayvonlari egalari mas'uliyatli bo'lishlari muhim. Ular uy hayvonlari yetarli mashq qilishiga va boshqa odamlar uchun muammo tug'dirmasligiga ishonch hosil qilishlari kerak.

Menimcha, agar odamlar mas'uliyatli uy hayvonlari egalari bo'lsa, ularga shaharlarda uy hayvonlarini saqlashga ruxsat berilmasligi uchun hech qanday sabab yo'q.
t2.uzSampleB2:
Odamlarga shaharlarda uy hayvonlarini saqlashga ruxsat berilishi kerakmi degan savol murakkab bo'lib, har ikki tomonning ham asosli dalillari mavjud. Men mas'uliyatli uy hayvonlari egaligi ruxsat etilishi kerak deb hisoblasam ham, potentsial qiyinchiliklarni tan olish juda muhim.

Bir tomondan, uy hayvonlari o'z egalariga sezilarli foyda keltiradi. Ular hamrohlikni ta'minlaydi, stressni kamaytiradi va hatto faolroq turmush tarzini rag'batlantirishi mumkin, ayniqsa uy hayvonlarini muntazam ravishda sayr qildirishi kerak bo'lgan it egalari uchun. Bundan tashqari, uy hayvonlari odamlar bog'larda va jamoat joylarida boshqa uy hayvonlari egalari bilan uchrashib, muloqot qilishlari sababli, jamiyat tuyg'usini rivojlantirishi mumkin.

Biroq, shahar muhiti uy hayvonlari va ularning egalari uchun qiyinchiliklar tug'dirishi mumkin. Kvartiralardagi cheklangan joy, shovqin ifloslanishi va osonlik bilan foydalanish mumkin bo'lgan yashil hududlarning yo'qligi hayvonning farovonligiga salbiy ta'sir ko'rsatishi mumkin. Bundan tashqari, uy hayvonlaridan keyin tozalashni yoki haddan tashqari hurishni nazorat qila olmaydigan mas'uliyatsiz uy hayvonlari egalari qo'shnilariga muammolar yaratishi mumkin. Shuning uchun shaharlarda uy hayvonlari egaligi barqaror va barcha aholining manfaatlarini hisobga olgan holda bo'lishini ta'minlash uchun qat'iy qoidalar va ularning ijrosi zarur.

t11.title: informal letter · to friend
t11.prompt: Write a letter to your friend, who just got a new puppy. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t11.sample: Hey! Congratulations on your new puppy! I know grooming can be tricky. I recently tried PawPerfect and they were absolutely wonderful with my dog. The staff were so gentle and patient. You should definitely take your puppy there – they'll take care of everything! Best wishes!
t11.sampleA2:
Hi Gulnora,
You have a puppy! That's good. I have a dog, too. I went to a groomer. It was okay. The dog is clean. You should groom your puppy. It's important. But it is expensive. Maybe you can do it. Bye!

You should check them out when your puppy needs a trim.
Best,
Shahnoza Ismoilova

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the pet grooming service. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample: Dear PawPerfect Team, Thank you for asking about my experience with your pet grooming service. I was extremely pleased with the care my dog received. Your staff were incredibly gentle and my pet seemed completely relaxed throughout. The grooming results were absolutely fantastic. However, I have some suggestions. The waiting time was rather long, even with an appointment. Additionally, the price list wasn't clearly displayed, which caused some confusion. I would love to see mobile grooming services for home visits. A loyalty card with discounts after multiple visits would be appreciated. Also, offering teeth cleaning and nail trimming packages would be convenient. Overall, I will certainly return with my pet. Yours sincerely, Shahnoza Ismoilova
t12.sampleA1:
Hi PawPerfect Team,
My dog is happy. Good job. I like the cut. Thank you.
Bye
t12.sampleA2:
Hello PawPerfect Team,
Thank you for my dog. He looks nice. The people are nice too. But the waiting is long and I don't like that. And the price is not clear. Maybe you can make it faster. I want a card for many times. Thank you.
Bye,
Shahnoza Ismoilova
t12.sampleB1:
Dear PawPerfect Team,

Thank you for your email. I wanted to tell you about my visit with my dog. I think the grooming was good and my dog looks very nice now. The staff were friendly and I appreciate that.

However, I think the waiting room could be better. It was a little small. Also, it would be good if you had more information about the different types of cuts. I was not sure which one to choose. I think it would also be useful if you offered discounts for regular customers.

Overall, I was happy with the service and I will come back again.

Sincerely,
Shahnoza Ismoilova
t12.sampleB2: Dear PawPerfect Team, Thank you for reaching out about my recent visit. I'm happy to share some feedback. Overall, I was thoroughly impressed with your service. My dog came home looking spotless, and your staff clearly went out of their way to keep him calm, which I really appreciated as he tends to get nervous around strangers. The online booking system was refreshingly straightforward and saved me a great deal of time. As for additional services, I would love to see mobile grooming for home visits, which would be a lifesaver on busy days. A loyalty scheme rewarding regular customers would also be a welcome touch, and perhaps a package combining grooming with teeth cleaning. All in all, it was a first-rate experience, and I will certainly be coming back. Yours sincerely, Bekzod Aliyev
t12.uzSample:
Hurmatli PawPerfect jamoasi,

Uy hayvonlarini parvarishlash xizmatingiz haqidagi tajribam bo'yicha so'rovingiz uchun rahmat.

Itimga ko'rsatilgan g'amxo'rlikdan juda mamnun bo'ldim. Xodimlaringiz juda mehribon edilar va uy hayvonim butun jarayon davomida o'zini butunlay xotirjam his qildi. Parvarishlash natijalari mutlaqo ajoyib edi.

Biroq, mening ba'zi takliflarim bor. Kutish vaqti ancha uzoq edi, hatto oldindan yozilgan bo'lsam ham. Bundan tashqari, narxlar ro'yxati aniq ko'rsatilmagan, bu esa biroz chalkashlikka olib keldi.

Uyga tashrif buyurish uchun mobil parvarishlash xizmatlarini ko'rishni juda xohlardim. Bir nechta tashriflardan so'ng chegirmalar bilan sodiqlik kartasi juda qadrlanadi. Shuningdek, tish tozalash va tirnoqlarni kesish paketlarini taklif qilish qulay bo'lardi.

Umuman olganda, men albatta uy hayvonim bilan qaytib kelaman.

Hurmat bilan,
Shahnoza Ismoilova
t12.uzSampleA1:

Mening itim xursand. Yaxshi ish. Soch turmagi menga yoqdi. Rahmat.
Xayr
t12.uzSampleA2:

Itingiz uchun rahmat. U chiroyli ko'rinadi. Odamlar ham yaxshi. Lekin kutish uzoq va menga bu yoqmaydi. Va narx aniq emas. Balki siz buni tezroq qilishingiz mumkin. Men ko'p marta uchun karta xohlayman. Rahmat.
Xayr,
Shahnoza Ismoilova

Hurmatli PawPerfect jamoasi,

Elektron pochtangiz uchun rahmat. Men itim bilan tashrifim haqida aytmoqchi edim. O'ylashimcha, parvarish yaxshi bo'ldi va itim hozir juda chiroyli ko'rinadi. Xodimlar do'stona munosabatda bo'lishdi va men bundan minnatdorman.

Biroq, men kutish xonasi yaxshiroq bo'lishi mumkin deb o'ylayman. U biroz kichik edi. Shuningdek, agar sizda turli xil soch turmagi haqida ko'proq ma'lumot bo'lsa, yaxshi bo'lardi. Men qaysi birini tanlashni bilmasdim. O'ylashimcha, agar siz doimiy mijozlar uchun chegirmalar taklif qilsangiz ham foydali bo'lardi.

Umuman olganda, men xizmatdan mamnun bo'ldim va yana qaytib kelaman.

Hurmat bilan,
Shahnoza Ismoilova
t12.uzSampleB2:
Hurmatli PawPerfect jamoasi,

Yaqinda bo'lib o'tgan uchrashuvim bo'yicha kuzatuv xatingiz uchun rahmat. Sizning parvarishlash xizmatlaringiz bilan bog'liq tajribam haqida fikr-mulohazalarimni bildirish uchun yozyapman.

Umuman olganda, parvarishlashning sifati meni juda qoniqtirdi. Uy hayvonimning juni ajoyib ko'rinadi va xodimlar aniq malakali va e'tiborli edilar. Band qilish jarayoni ham nisbatan sodda edi.

Biroq, menimcha, yaxshilanishi mumkin bo'lgan bir nechta sohalar mavjud. Birinchidan, kutish joyi biroz tor edi va etarli o'rindiqlar yo'q edi. Ikkinchidan, men parvarishlash uslubi bo'yicha maslahatlashuv yanada chuqurroq bo'lishi kerak deb his qildim. Ehtimol, vizual misollar yoki har bir variantning batafsilroq tushuntirilishi foydali bo'lar edi.

Qo'shimcha xizmatlar nuqtai nazaridan, men turli xil jun turlari yoki teri sezgirligi uchun moslashtirilgan maxsus shampunlar variantlarini ko'rishdan manfaatdor bo'lardim. Bundan tashqari, parvarishlashni boshqa xizmatlar, masalan, tish tozalash bilan birlashtirgan paketlarni taklif qilish mijozlar uchun jozibali bo'lishi mumkin.

Ushbu kichik nuqtalarga qaramay, men umumiy xizmatdan mamnun bo'ldim va kelajakda PawPerfect Groomingdan yana foydalanishni o'ylab ko'raman.

Hurmat bilan,
Shahnoza Ismoilova
